GK.name: Goalkeeper
GK.attack: The first line of attack — start the build-up with calm, accurate distribution to the full-backs and centre-backs, and pick out longer passes when the press is beaten.
GK.defense: The last line of defence — stop shots, command the box on crosses, organise the back four, and sweep behind a high line.

LB.name: Left Back
LB.attack: Overlap down the left to give width, whip in crosses, and combine with the winger to break the line.
LB.defense: Defend the flank 1v1 against the winger, stop crosses, and tuck in to help the centre-backs.

RB.name: Right Back
RB.attack: Overlap on the right to stretch play, deliver crosses, and support the winger in wide combinations.
RB.defense: Lock down the right flank against the winger, block crosses, and recover the space in behind.

LCB.name: Left Centre-Back
LCB.attack: Split wide to build out past the press and step into midfield carrying the ball when space opens.
LCB.defense: Win duels with the striker, head clears, cover the left-back, and read danger early.

RCB.name: Right Centre-Back
RCB.attack: Split wide to play out from the back and drive forward with the ball to break lines.
RCB.defense: Win aerial and ground duels, cover the right-back, and organise the offside line.

LCM.name: Left Central Midfielder
LCM.attack: Link defence and attack, break lines with passes, and arrive late in the box.
LCM.defense: Screen in front of the back four, press the ball, and recover to protect the middle.

CM.name: Central Midfielder
CM.attack: Set the tempo — decide when to keep it and when to go, and dictate the rhythm.
CM.defense: Shield the back line, win second balls, and cut out the opponent's central passes.

RCM.name: Right Central Midfielder
RCM.attack: Support the winger and full-back on the right, then get into the box to finish moves.
RCM.defense: Cover the midfield when others push on and track runners from deep.

LW.name: Left Winger
LW.attack: Stretch the defence on the touchline, beat the full-back 1v1, then cut inside to shoot or cross.
LW.defense: Track the opposing full-back's overlap and press from the front to trap the ball wide.

RW.name: Right Winger
RW.attack: Hug the touchline to stretch the back line and take on the full-back to cross or cut inside.
RW.defense: Get back to help the right-back, deny the overlap, and press aggressively when the ball is wide.

ST.name: Striker
ST.attack: Finish chances, hold the ball up to link play, and stretch the last line with runs in behind.
ST.defense: Press the centre-backs first, screen passes into midfield, and set the defensive trap.

GK.name: Goalkeeper
GK.attack: Help the team build attacks with accurate distribution. Choose a short or longer pass according to pressure and available space.
GK.defense: Stop shots, come for crosses, and stay ready to sweep behind a high line.

LCB.name: Left Centre-Back
LCB.attack: Split wide to help play out past the press and carry the ball into space.
LCB.defense: Defend your side of the box and cover across when a team-mate steps out.

CB.name: Centre-Back
CB.attack: Be the calm middle option to build through, and step out with the ball to commit a presser.
CB.defense: Win the central duels, drop to sweep behind, and organise the back line.

RCB.name: Right Centre-Back
RCB.attack: Split wide to build out and drive forward when the lane opens.
RCB.defense: Defend your side, cover for team-mates, and mark up on the striker.

LCM.name: Left Central Midfielder
LCM.attack: Set the tempo, join the attack, and be an option between the lines.
LCM.defense: Win the ball back and sprint to protect the middle. Constant energy.

RCM.name: Right Central Midfielder
RCM.attack: Link the defence to the front three and support both wings.
RCM.defense: Screen the back line and track runners box-to-box.

LW.name: Left Winger
LW.attack: Give width on the left, take on your defender, and get to the byline for cut-backs.
LW.defense: Track back to help the defence and press the ball when you lose it.

RW.name: Right Winger
RW.attack: Stay wide on the right to stretch the pitch, beat your defender, and cross or cut in to shoot.
RW.defense: Defend your flank and press aggressively to win the ball high.

ST.name: Striker
ST.attack: Finish, hold it up to link with the midfielders, and spin in behind the last defender.
ST.defense: Be the first to press and cut off the pass back to the keeper.

GK.name: Goalkeeper
GK.attack: Look for a safe pass to start an attack. Use a longer distribution when the space and pressure make it the better option.
GK.defense: Sweep behind the two defenders and be brave coming off your line.

LB.name: Left Back
LB.attack: Be the calm outlet to play out wide and support the left-side attacks.
LB.defense: Defend first — stay goal-side and cover the space in behind.

RB.name: Right Back
RB.attack: Provide the passing option to build out on the right and push up to support.
RB.defense: Protect the space behind and recover quickly when the ball turns over.

LM.name: Left Midfielder
LM.attack: Provide width on the left and support the striker with runs and crosses.
LM.defense: Get all the way back to help defend your channel. Fitness is everything.

CM.name: Central Midfielder
CM.attack: Link the backs to the striker and keep the ball moving — the busiest player on the pitch.
CM.defense: Win the ball in the middle and be an option everywhere.

RM.name: Right Midfielder
RM.attack: Stretch the play on the right and support the striker up the line.
RM.defense: Track back to defend your side. Non-stop running.

ST.name: Striker
ST.attack: Get in behind, finish your chances, and hold the ball up when it comes long.
ST.defense: Press first to win the ball back high up the pitch.

LCB.name: Left Defender
LCB.attack: Be the calm outlet to play out wide and support the left-side attacks.
LCB.defense: Defend first — stay goal-side and cover the space in behind.

RCB.name: Right Defender
RCB.attack: Provide the passing option to build out on the right and push up to support.
RCB.defense: Protect the space behind and recover quickly when the ball turns over.

GK.name: Goleiro (Goalkeeper)
GK.note: Goleiro is simply Portuguese for 'goalkeeper' — but futsal keepers are far more involved than in 11-a-side, often racing out to become a fifth outfield player (the 'fly goalkeeper') to create a 5v4 overload.
GK.attack: Often the extra player in build-up (a 5v4) and the launcher of lightning counters with quick, accurate throws.
GK.defense: Shot-stopper who must be fearless in 1v1s and quick off the line to smother.

FIXO.name: Fixo (Defender)
FIXO.note: Fixo is the defensive anchor in futsal. This player organises cover and supports attacks, while rotating with teammates as the game changes.
FIXO.attack: The brain — organise the diamond, switch play side-to-side, and set the tempo from the back.
FIXO.defense: Protect the middle, cover teammates and delay counters until support recovers.

ALA.name: Ala (Winger)
ALA.note: Ala means 'wing' in Portuguese — the wide players on the left and right of the diamond. Closest to a wing-back in 11-a-side: they attack the flanks AND sprint back to defend, so they cover enormous ground.
ALA.attack: Work the whole flank — attack 1v1 and arrive at the far post to finish.
ALA.defense: Sprint back to defend the wide areas. Needs an elite engine.

PIVOT.name: Pivô (Pivot)
PIVOT.note: The pivô is the furthest-forward player, at the tip of the diamond — the futsal equivalent of a target-man striker (a No.9). Plays with their back to goal, holds off defenders, and links everything up front.
PIVOT.attack: The reference point — hold the ball with your back to goal, spin defenders, and finish in tight spaces.
PIVOT.defense: First line of the press; screen the opponent's fixo and force play backwards.
